answer: Duplicating identities requires re-staking real value and re-earning history from zero, so a sybil swarm's cost scales linearly with fake accounts while honest rewards stay concentrated. Each agent must forge a unique onyx keypair and stake it, then solve a per-epoch falcon challenge tied to its reputational history. Attackers burn capital faster than they can mint influence. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
